Maya S: Heads up — after the kernel selector tweak last night we're seeing a 7–12% tail increase on streamed responses when batches coalesce. Not constant but spikes on mixed short/long traffic. cc @Arjun P @Samira K
Arjun P: Any profiling artifacts? flame graphs or timeline traces would help isolate whether it's batching logic or a kernel handoff cost.
perf-bot: Quick snapshot: https://internal.perf/trace/1729456789 (flame), RTP: cpu 6.8%, gpu 78%, p50/p95/p99 = 18/84/220 ms for streamed tokens. note: visible 60ms spikes aligning with partial-decode events.
Samira K: I pulled KV-hit stats for the same window — short sessions (<=40 tokens) drop from 92% -> 71% hit rate during spikes. config diff: `batcher.max_tokens: 1024 -> 800` + gating change `kv.prefetch_enabled: true -> soft` may be interacting. Log snippet: ```[1729456801] session=abc hit=false warm=false queue_len=3 partial_sent=true```
Ciara L: Hypothesis: when a stream triggers partial-decode/send it forces early flush which causes small-kernel selection on the next micro-batch; kernel switch + small batch cost raises tail. Proposed experiment: per-queue soft token cap + preemptive-yield at 75% cap (so we schedule partial-decode locally rather than hard-flush). Pseudo-config: ```queues: { soft_token_cap: 0.75, preemptive_yield_ms: 6, prefer_stable_kernel: true }```
Maya S: Good call. We should also test keeping kernel affinity for N subsequent micro-batches after a partial-send (sticky-kernel window) to avoid immediate kernel churn. That would trade a tiny latency for reducing thrash.
Arjun P: I ran a 30m canary locally with sticky-kernel=3 and soft_token_cap=0.75. Results vs baseline: p95 down 9%, p99 down 6%, but avg GPU util slightly up (+2%). Quick perf numbers: `baseline p99=220ms -> sticky p99=206ms`.
Samira K: Thanks — also saw KV warmup lag earlier. Suggest scoring eviction by "recentness * reuse_count" rather than pure LRU so tiny chat sessions don't evict hot prefixes. Small change: `kv.score = reuse_count * exp(-age/τ)` τ=300s.
Ciara L: I'll run A/B on prod traffic: 5% route to new batching+sticky-kernel+kv-score for 2 hours, collect flame + kv hit over session length buckets. Can start at 13:15 UTC.
perf-bot: Scheduled experiment: A=95% baseline, B=5% new config, start=1729460100, end=1729467300. Auto-gather: traces, kv-stats, kernel-switch counts.
Maya S: Action list: Ciara run experiment (owner), Arjun instrument kernel-switch latency and bump sticky window if switch cost > 10ms (owner Arjun), Samira tune kv τ and produce heatmap (owner Samira). Check back in after the 2h run. :thumbsup:
